name: Shanghai Stonehill Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Stonehill Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides internet information services in China. The company develops software products, including 2345 Website Navigation, Browser, Security Guard, 2345 HaoZip, Image Viewer, Input Method, 2345 Weather Forecast, and Qingniao Wallpaper. It also provides Nullmax, a platform which offers various driver assistance features.
